name: Capital University
tuition_note: Private university, single published rate. 2026-27 full-time traditional undergraduate tuition $45,100/year (does not include $500/year fees: activity $100, health/wellness $110, technology $290) from capital.edu/admission-aid/office-of-financial-aid/tuition-fees/. Housing is room only: traditional-hall double $6,800/year (single $8,500) from capital.edu/admission-aid/office-of-financial-aid/tuition-fees/room-board/, board (meal plans) listed separately.
